newsitem.title: USA: GlobalCenter adds Web publishing services.
newsitem.headline: GlobalCenter adds Web publishing services.

text.p: GlobalCenter Inc said it had begun offering a cost-effective method for small and medium-size companies to create and maintain an Internet Web site for a fee of $100 a month.

GlobalCenter, which was spun off from Global Village Communication Inc in January, said customers with little or no Internet experience could use its Web Publishing service to set up a prototype Web site themselves in less than an hour.
The service can include Web-based online registration, automatic Web site set-up, customer Web site naming, a Web content preview area and online usage and billing reports.
The $100 monthly Web Publishing fee includes the ability to change the Web site at any time, and immediate access to real- time on-demand reports to monitor the site.

The fee also covers up to 25 megabytes of storage capacity and 1,500 megabytes of network traffic. Added capacity can be obtained for incremental amounts: $5 per megabyte of additional storage and $100 per 100 megabytes of bandwidth.
GlobalCenter offers an array of Internet services for businesses, including 24-hour/7-day a week Internet access, custom domain name registration and integrated e-mail.
